sourceReview: Generator verifies Node/package pins and all dependency trees before assembling exact two-artifact catalog.

Processed artifacts each require nonempty private function inventory, bytecode, ABI and VK; all embedded dependencies and local source hashes checked. Independent read-only checks reproduced 14/6 private VK inventories, 132/129 embedded dependencies, seven/one local files, and eight-package/419-file dependency closure.

Generator writes only the catalog, then invokes existing strict loader; catch restores previous catalog bytes and propagates failure. No build, proof, upload, service registration or deployment operation.
Expected generated catalog digest independently reconstructed from checked source and current bytes: fafaf3387cdb360e11dff386f30be2fac40e5547ee642cb969aac449b40efb7e
conditions: Lead owns invocation and sole declared catalog mutation; preserve old catalog and receipt, then compare actual output against independently reconstructed digest and reload outcome.
Review actual catalog and final generated snapshot before exact generated-output commit/transfer.
Bootstrap catalog pin, native Linux qualification and deployment changes require their separate claims/reviews.
limitations: Catalog status ready represents local normal artifact/source binding only. It does not clear TXE, genuine rc3 runtime, full cold recovery, remote deployment or production release gates.
